questions.q: (a) Perimeter of a sector radius 9 cm, angle 80° [3] (b) A solid is a cylinder r = 3 cm, h = 10 cm with a hemisphere on top: volume in terms of π [3] (c) Cone r = 5 cm, h = 12 cm: volume and curved surface area [4] (d) A sphere has volume 500 cm³: radius [4]
A cone and a sphere have the same radius r and the same volume. Find the cone's height in terms of r.
Volume of a hemisphere radius 4.5 cm (3 s.f.)
Sector radius 7 cm has arc length 11 cm. Find the angle.
A sphere has surface area 144π cm². Find its radius.
